gain_residual_contract.application: g_p g_q* multiplies signal and thermal noise; nominal response remains fixed

profile_definitions.ripple: Independent station sinusoids with 2 cycles across the input band

gain_residual_contract.rms_normalization: Per-realization RMS over the station-frequency grid after removing its realization-wide mean

limitations: Thermal samples repeat one frozen LST track rather than adding new uv tracks.
Gain residuals are direction-independent phenomenological stress models.
RFI, ionosphere, and correlated receiver noise are not injected.
Known flags are zero-filled inside the fixed DPSS basis; no DAYENUREST-style inpainting is used.
The archived PB mismatch comparison comes from an earlier paired 64-to-32 run rather than the local-redshift noise baseline.

primary_beam_mismatch.comparison_contract: Paired PB result from the earlier 64-to-32 response run; absolute metrics must not be mixed with the local-redshift baseline.

thermal_noise_contract.estimator: Re[(L V_A) conj(L V_B)] with independent Gaussian noise splits
thermal_noise_contract.integration_interpretation: Equivalent repeats of the frozen 320-s LST track; total time is distributed uniformly over its time bins and two splits.
